leadText:
The captain is a character of the day who appeared in The Lost World of Gothitelle!. He was not given an official name in the Japanese version or any of the dubs.

He first appeared in an illusion created by , which depicted his time as the young captain of a water taxi that transported passengers from the outskirts of Pinwheel Forest to Castelia City, before the Skyarrow Bridge was built. On board was his daughter Sally, who gave snacks to passengers, and a Gothitelle who helped her. , , and appeared in this illusion and boarded the ferry.

The captain later appeared in Sally's flashback, in which he closed down the ferry business after Skyarrow Bridge was completed. He, his daughter and Gothitelle soon moved to a new city where Sally's uncle operated a factory. While Sally left home to study to become a doctor, Gothitelle mysteriously disappeared.
